move: seven iMacs cascade in from the right, fan, straighten to camera
how: Seven CSS-built iMacs (display, chin, stand, foot coloured by --c) start at x 900 / rotateY -35 / scale 0.9 / opacity 0 stacked at the same spot. One by one (0.12s offsets, expo.out 1s) they slide left to their slot (i - 3) * 150px, arriving at rotateY -14 so the row reads as a fan; at 37% all straighten to rotateY 0 with power3.inOut over 0.8s (stagger 0.03) and the masked headline and subline rise (expo.out). The whole row drifts x 30→-30 linearly for parallax, and a brightness(1)→1.35 filter sweep runs across the screens yoyo with stagger 0.08 at 57%. Exit at 82%: each iMac flies to x -900 / rotateY 30 / opacity 0 with expo.in at 0.05s offsets, text exits upward.
adapt: Change the number of units and their --c/--h1/--h2 colours (slot pitch is 150px for seven), the headline and subline; keep the 0.12s cascade offset and the 0.8s straighten.
port: mount(el, shot) creates N .imac elements with inline CSS variables and the text block; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with cascade 0.02-0.4D, straighten at 0.37D, sweep at 0.57D, exit from 0.82D. The perspective on .stage must be applied to el; selectors via el.querySelectorAll('.imac').
caveats: filter: brightness tween on seven screens
perspective is on the stage container
